verdict.rationale: Mem0's search API explicitly accepts natural-language queries and its MCP server exposes memory tools so an agent can decide in natural language when to save/search/update, and the CLI supports a --json agent mode for programmatic NL-driven use (mem0-docs-7, mem0-docs-2, mem0-probe-rt-1). However, core operations (add/update/delete) are structured API/CLI calls rather than a native conversational command interface, and no evidence shows a chat-style NL command shell for the product itself. Missing for 10: a first-party conversational interface where arbitrary natural-language commands (not just search queries) drive add/update/delete/list operations, and independent hands-on confirmation of this NL command experience.
